stage1.impression: A dark oak-slat room with two red acrylic speakers on terrazzo blocks and, between them, a multi-coloured neon gyroscope, which is what the eye goes to first. The speakers glow a flat, even red from inside as if self-lit, the horn tops show wavy, smeared stripe reflections, the slat wall is a perfectly regular CG pattern lit brighter at the top than the floor, and the room is empty (no listeners, no glass, no record), so it reads as a showroom render. As it stands a magazine would not run it as a specific place: the slat wall, chairs and plinths are generic, and the neon sculpture makes it read as a nightclub installation.

blocking_9: Mother EARF's rims must not be the brightest, most saturated thing in the frame: the Ember pair has to be the hero at a glance (product decision, see out_of_scope)
Speaker bodies need modelled light (a hot side, a falling-off side, glowing polished edges) rather than a uniform internal red: the speaker region's lum_median at 45 or more with visible gradients
The floor and plinths must carry the pools of light (a spot pool under each plinth, Mother's coloured shadow on the end-grain floor) and must not be darker than the upper wall
Signs of life: listeners (motion-blurred) in the lounge chairs, a glass and a record sleeve, a rug that reads
Clean, undistorted reflections in the horn acrylic; no wavy stripe smears
The slat wall needs irregularity: tone variation board to board, grain, grazing falloff, not a uniform barcode

defects.what: Mother EARF's rims in saturated blue, green, yellow and pink neon dominate the frame and break the one-colour rule; reads as nightclub or signage
Right speaker body glows a flat, even red (r_median 64, g 4, b 1) with no light direction; reads as lit plastic, not thick cast acrylic
Left speaker is the same uniform internal red glow, no modelling, edges not glowing
Horn acrylic shows wobbly, wavy stripe reflections of the slat wall and a dark blob; lum_median 11.8, crush 15.7%
Left horn has the same smeared wavy reflections
Floor at the far end crushed dark (lum_median 10.6); no pools under the plinths and no coloured shadow from Mother EARF
Upper slat wall is the brightest neutral area (lum_median 41), brighter than the speakers' faces and floor: light distribution upside down
Slat wall repeats with perfect regularity, no board-to-board tone variation or grain at 1:1
Lounge chairs empty and stiff, rug barely reads, no listeners, glasses or records anywhere in the frame
Black slab on the left reads as an undefined dark box
Foreground chair back cut off by the frame edge; reads as an obstruction, not a deliberate foreground
Mother's plinth is dark and undifferentiated (lum_median 10.1); terrazzo chips read noisy rather than honed

changes.problem: The pair glow a flat internal red with no direction, so the acrylic reads as lit plastic and the speakers are dimmer than the wall above them.

evidence.measured: lum_median 18.3 (target 45 or more), r 64 / g 4 / b 1, uniform glow; upper wall lum_median 41

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots
change.to: 2 x spot 90 W, 18 deg, 2700 K, aimed from 30-40 deg off-axis high so one side and the top edges catch light and the far side falls off

changes.expected: Speakers become the brightest objects in the frame with a visible light side and glowing polished edges; speaker region lum_median about 50

changes.problem: Mother EARF's neon rims outshine and out-saturate the Ember pair; her plinth and coloured shadow are invisible.

evidence.measured: multiple saturated hues (blue, green, yellow, pink) at clip 0.72%; her plinth lum_median 10.1

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF spot; and the grade
change.to: 1 x spot 30 W, 26 deg, aimed down through the discs so their tinted shadow lands on the floor in front of the plinth; the rims' visual weight drops relative to the pair once c1 lifts them

changes.expected: The pair read first, Mother second; a soft coloured shadow pool appears on the floor at 600-780 x 640-700

changes.problem: The light distribution is upside down: the upper wall is lit and the floor and plinths are crushed, so there are no pools of light.

change.setting: the baffle's graze and the inside fill
change.to: graze 0.3 W/m2 from the floor upward so the wall falls off toward the ceiling; trap 0.15 W/m2 aimed at the floor in front of the plinths

changes.expected: Upper wall darkens to about lum_median 28; the floor between the plinths becomes a warm pool

changes.problem: The room is empty: no listeners, glasses or records, so it reads as a showroom.

change.to: 2 listeners in the lounge chairs, backs to camera, motion-blurred (shutter 1/8 s equivalent); a whisky glass on a chair arm, a record sleeve leaning on the right plinth

changes.expected: A sign of life in the foreground and middle ground; the frame reads as a room in use

changes.problem: The horn acrylic shows wobbly, smeared reflections of the slat wall, the clearest sign of cheap acrylic.

change.from: as rendered (wavy reflections, as if from bumped or bent normals)
change.to: perfectly smooth normals on the horn surfaces (no bump, roughness 0.0-0.02), and a soft rim/back light catching the horn's polished edge

changes.expected: Clean, continuous reflections and a glowing edge line on the horn's lip; crush in the horn region below 8%

changes.problem: The oak slat wall is a perfectly regular barcode with no grain or board-to-board variation.

evidence.measured: uniform repeated stripes; lum_range 96 entirely from slat/gap alternation

change.setting: the oak's tone (finish within its kind)
change.to: per-slat random tone variation of plus or minus 8%, visible grain, slightly softer slat edges

changes.expected: The wall reads as real oiled oak at 1:1; the pattern stops reading as a texture

changes.problem: The terrazzo plinths read as coarse noisy gravel, dark and undifferentiated, not honed terrazzo.

change.setting: the terrazzo's chip size and ground tone
change.from: large dark chips in a dark ground
change.to: chips at about half the size in a warmer, lighter ground, honed (roughness 0.35) so the spot pools give a soft sheen on the plinth tops

changes.expected: Plinths read as honed stone with a lit top face

changes.problem: The foreground chair back is cut by the bottom edge, and the left side (black slab, empty chairs) takes a third of the frame with nothing to say.

evidence.measured: a cut-off chair back in the bottom edge; left third lum_median about 27, no subject

change.to: move 0.4 m right and 0.3 m back, 35 mm, so the pair and Mother are centred with a listener's shoulder as a deliberate soft foreground on one side

changes.expected: A symmetrical, calmer composition with the pair as the subject

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's rims a single warm or Ember-related tint, or lower their emission substantially
out_of_scope.why: Her disc tints and glowing rims are a fixed product as placed; but in this frame their four saturated colours break the one-colour rule and compete with the pair, the main thing between this and an 8

out_of_scope.request: Thicker, visibly polished edges on the Tropos cabinet panels
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's construction is fixed; at present the panels read thin and uniformly lit
